31119-punch-or-the-london-charivari-vol-.title: Punch Or The London Charivari Vol 158 June 9 1920
31119-punch-or-the-london-charivari-vol-.creator: Unknown
31119-punch-or-the-london-charivari-vol-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. We understand that the Scotsman who was injured in the rush outside the post-office on the last night of the three-halfpenny postage, is now able to get about with the help of a stick.

arxiv-2207-10826.title: Label-free quantum super-resolution imaging using entangled multi-mode squeezed light
arxiv-2207-10826.creator: Daniel Soh, Eric Chatterjee
arxiv-2207-10826.description: Abstract In this study, we explore the theoretical application of entangled multi-mode squeezed light for label-free optical super-resolution imaging. By generating massively entangled multi-mode squeezed light through an array of balanced beam splitters, using a single-mode squeezed light input, we create a multi-mode quantum light state with exceptional entanglement and noise suppression below the shot noise level.

arxiv-2209-08168.title: FluTO: Graded Multiscale Fluid Topology Optimization using Neural Networks
arxiv-2209-08168.creator: Rahul Kumar Padhy, Aaditya Chandrasekhar, Krishnan Suresh
arxiv-2209-08168.description: Abstract Fluid-flow devices with low dissipation, but high contact area, are of importance in many applications. A well-known strategy to design such devices is multi-scale topology optimization (MTO), where optimal microstructures are designed within each cell of a discretized domain.

arxiv-2406-01809.title: Use the 4S (Signal-Safe Speckle Subtraction): Explainable Machine Learning reveals the Giant Exoplanet AF Lep b in High-Contrast Imaging Data from 2011
arxiv-2406-01809.creator: Markus J. Bonse, Timothy D. Gebhard, Felix A. Dannert, Olivier Absil, Faustine Cantalloube, Valentin Christiaens, Gabriele Cugno, Emily O. Garvin, Jean Hayoz, Markus Kasper, Elisabeth Matthews, Bernhard Schölkopf, Sascha P. Quanz
arxiv-2406-01809.description: Abstract The main challenge of exoplanet high-contrast imaging (HCI) is to separate the signal of exoplanets from their host stars, which are many orders of magnitude brighter. HCI for ground-based observations is further exacerbated by speckle noise originating from perturbations in Earth’s atmosphere and imperfections in the telescope optics.

arxiv-2409-05091.title: Extremal Contractions of Projective Bundles
arxiv-2409-05091.creator: Ashima Bansal, Supravat Sarkar, Shivam Vats
arxiv-2409-05091.description: Abstract In this article, we explore the extremal contractions of several projective bundles over smooth Fano varieties of Picard rank 1 1 . We provide a whole class of examples of projective bundles with smooth blow-up structures, derived from the notion of drums which was introduced by Occhetta-Romano-Conde-Wiśniewski to study interaction with ℂ ∗ \mathbb{C}^{*} -actions and birational geometry.

arxiv-2412-04773.title: Robust Gradient Descent Estimation for Tensor Models under Heavy-Tailed Distributions
arxiv-2412-04773.creator: Xiaoyu Zhang, Di Wang, Guodong Li, Defeng Sun
arxiv-2412-04773.description: Abstract Low-rank tensor models are widely used in statistics. However, most existing methods rely heavily on the assumption that data follows a sub-Gaussian distribution. To address the challenges associated with heavy-tailed distributions encountered in real-world applications, we propose a novel robust estimation procedure based on truncated gradient descent for general low-rank tensor models.

arxiv-2510-02026.title: A Large Sample of JWST/NIRSpec Brown Dwarfs: New Distant Discoveries NumPy ( C. R. Harris et al. 2020 ) , Scipy ( P. Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , Matplotlib ( J. D. Hunter 2007 ) , UltraNest ( J. Buchner 2021 ) , SPLAT ( A. J. Burgasser & Splat Development Team 2017 )
arxiv-2510-02026.creator: Zhijun Tu, Shu Wang, Xiaodian Chen, Jifeng Liu
arxiv-2510-02026.description: Abstract Brown dwarfs are essential probes of stellar and planetary formation, yet their low luminosities pose challenges for detection at large Galactic distances. The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), with its unprecedented near-infrared sensitivity, enables the discovery and characterization of distant substellar objects, including those in the Milky Way’s thick disk and halo.

arxiv-2510-11479.title: A Metal-Rich Atmosphere with a Super-Solar C/O Ratio for the Extreme Ultra-Hot Jupiter WASP-178b
arxiv-2510-11479.creator: Suman Saha, James S. Jenkins
arxiv-2510-11479.description: Abstract The population of ultra-hot Jupiters (UHJs) provide unique opportunities to probe the extreme formation and evolutionary pathways in exoplanets. Owing to their very high temperatures and inflated atmospheres, UHJs are among the most favorable targets for both transmission and emission spectroscopy, enabling detailed characterization of their atmospheric properties.

arxiv-2512-12010.title: Convergence of the Cumulant Expansion and Polynomial-Time Algorithm for Weakly Interacting Fermions
arxiv-2512-12010.creator: Hongrui Chen, Cambyse Rouzé, Jielun Chen, Jiaqing Jiang, Samuel O. Scalet, Yongtao Zhan, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan, Lexing Ying, Yu Tong
arxiv-2512-12010.description: Abstract We propose a randomized algorithm to compute the log-partition function of weakly interacting fermions with polynomial runtime in both the system size and precision. Although weakly interacting fermionic systems are considered tractable for many computational methods such as the diagrammatic quantum Monte Carlo, a mathematically rigorous proof of polynomial runtime has been lacking.

arxiv-2601-13296.title: Limit Theorems for θ \theta -expansions and the Failure of the Strong Law
arxiv-2601-13296.creator: Andreas Rusu, Gabriela Ileana Sebe, Dan Lascu
arxiv-2601-13296.description: Abstract The paper presents fundamental metrical theorems for a class of continued fraction-like expansions known as θ \theta -expansions. We first prove Khinchine’s Weak Law of Large Numbers for the sum of digits, followed by the Diamond-Vaaler Strong Law for the sum of digits minus the largest one.

europmc-pmc4267669.title: Easy quantitative assessment of genome editing by sequence trace decomposition.
europmc-pmc4267669.creator: Brinkman EK, Chen T, Amendola M, van Steensel B.
europmc-pmc4267669.description: The efficacy and the mutation spectrum of genome editing methods can vary substantially depending on the targeted sequence. A simple, quick assay to accurately characterize and quantify the induced mutations is therefore needed. Here we present TIDE, a method for this purpose...

europmc-pmc5337987.title: Conductive porous vanadium nitride/graphene composite as chemical anchor of polysulfides for lithium-sulfur batteries.
europmc-pmc5337987.creator: Sun Z, Zhang J, Yin L, Hu G, Fang R, Cheng HM, Li F.
europmc-pmc5337987.description: Although the rechargeable lithium-sulfur battery is an advanced energy storage system, its practical implementation has been impeded by many issues, in particular the shuttle effect causing rapid capacity fade and low Coulombic efficiency. Herein, we report a conductive porous...

pmc-10711551.title: Structural basis for the allosteric regulation and dynamic assembly of DNMT3B
pmc-10711551.creator: Jiuwei Lu, Jian Fang, Hongtao Zhu, Kimberly Lu Liang, Nelli Khudaverdyan, Jikui Song
pmc-10711551.description: Oligomerization of DNMT3B, a mammalian de novo DNA methyltransferase, critically regulates its chromatin targeting and DNA methylation activities. However, how the N-terminal PWWP and ADD domains interplay with the C-terminal methyltransferase (MTase) domain in regulating the dynamic assembly of DNMT3B remains unclear. Here, we report the cryo-EM structure of DNMT3B under various oligomerization states.

pmc-10712143.title: The epidemiology of primary FSGS including cluster analysis over a 20-year period
pmc-10712143.creator: Thomas McDonnell, Joshua Storrar, Rajkumar Chinnadurai, Calvin Heal, Constantina Chrysochou, James Ritchie, Francesco Rainone, Dimitrios Poulikakos, Philip Kalra, Smeeta Sinha
pmc-10712143.description: IntroductionFocal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) is one of the leading causes of nephrotic syndrome in adults. This epidemiological study describes a renal centre’s 20-year experience of primary FSGS.MethodsPatients were identified with a diagnosis of primary FSGS after exclusion of known secondary causes. In this retrospective observational study, data was collected for baseline demographics, immunosuppression and outcomes.

pmc-11417777.title: Therapeutic Advances in Psoriasis: From Biologics to Emerging Oral Small Molecules
pmc-11417777.creator: Francesco Ferrara, Chiara Verduci, Emanuela Laconi, Andrea Mangione, Chiara Dondi, Marta Del Vecchio, Veronica Carlevatti, Andrea Zovi, Maurizio Capuozzo, Roberto Langella
pmc-11417777.description: Psoriasis is a persistent, inflammatory condition affecting millions globally, marked by excessive keratinocyte proliferation, immune cell infiltration, and widespread inflammation. Over the years, therapeutic approaches have developed significantly, shifting from conventional topical treatments and phototherapy to more sophisticated systemic interventions such as biologics and, recently, oral small-molecule drugs.

pmc-11523597.title: Estimates of intra-cluster correlation coefficients from 2018 USA Medicare data to inform the design of cluster randomized trials in Alzheimer’s and related dementias
pmc-11523597.creator: Yongdong Ouyang, Fan Li, Xiaojuan Li, Julie Bynum, Vincent Mor, Monica Taljaard
pmc-11523597.description: BackgroundCluster randomized trials (CRTs) are increasingly important for evaluating interventions embedded in health care systems. An essential parameter in sample size calculation to detect both overall and heterogeneous treatment effects for CRTs is the intra-cluster correlation coefficient (ICC) of both outcome and covariates of interest. However, obtaining advance estimates for the ICC can be challenging.

pmc-11524303.title: Leaf mechanical properties as potential predictors of leaf-litter decomposability
pmc-11524303.creator: Wenshan Li, Zhenya Liu, Jianfeng Zhao, Liangfan Ma, Jiahao Wu, Jinfeng Qi, Hang Wang
pmc-11524303.description: The mechanical resistance of plant leaves to herbivores and physical disturbances have a lasting legacy impact on leaf-litter decomposition rates and nutrient leaching. However, in the past, leaf mechanics were seldom considered as key factors in regulating ecological processes related to leaf-litter decomposition.

pmc-11537853.title: Distinct acute stressors produce different intensity of anxiety-like behavior and differential glutamate release in zebrafish brain
pmc-11537853.creator: Milena Letícia Martins, Emerson Feio Pinheiro, Geovanna Ayami Saito, Caroline Araújo Costa De Lima, Luana Ketlen Reis Leão, Evander de Jesus Oliveira Batista, Adelaide da Conceição Fonseca Passos, Amauri Gouveia, Karen Renata Herculano Matos Oliveira, Anderson Manoel Herculano
pmc-11537853.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Anxiety disorder is one of the most well-characterized behavioral disorders in individuals subjected to acute or chronic stress. However, few studies have demonstrated how different types of stressors can modulate the neurochemical alterations involved in the generation of anxiety. In this study, we hypothesize that subjects exposed to different aversive stimuli (mechanical, chemical, and spatial restriction) present varied intensities of anxiety-like responses associated with distinct patterns of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and glutamate release in the brain.

pmc-11593961.title: Role of the ACE I/D Polymorphism in Selected Public Health-Associated Sporting Modalities: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11593961.creator: Lydia Sommers, Liz Akam, David John Hunter, Jasvinder Singh Bhatti, Sarabjit Mastana, Pantelis T Nikolaidis, Paul B Tchounwou
pmc-11593961.description: Background: The ACE I/D polymorphism has been suggested to be associated with multiple chronic diseases and sports modalities, which has public health implications for global populations and sport performance. This updated review aims to strengthen the association and identify sporting disciplines that are most influenced by the ACE gene polymorphism using a meta-analysis approach.

pmc-12470548.title: Prognostic Role of MMP2, MMP9, and IL-1β Markers in Cardiac Allograft Rejection After Transplantation
pmc-12470548.creator: Gabriela Patrichi, Catalin-Bogdan Satala, Andrei Ionut Patrichi, Alexandru-Nicusor Tomut, Ovidiu Simion Cotoi, Horatiu Suciu, Anca Ileana Sin
pmc-12470548.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cardiac allograft rejection remains a major cause of graft dysfunction post-transplant. While histology is the current diagnostic standard, it may miss early immune and inflammatory events. This study evaluated the immunohistochemical expression of matrix metalloproteinases 2 (MMP2), 9 (MMP9), and interleukin-1 beta (IL-1β) in cardiac transplant patients, correlating their expression with acute cellular rejection (ACR), antibody-mediated rejection (AMR), inflammation, vasculitis, the Quilty effect, and immune markers. Fifty-nine endomyocardial biopsy specimens were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-12554062.title: Estimating the health and economic burden of Chagas cardiomyopathy in the United States: a population-based analysis
pmc-12554062.creator: Steffany Vucetich, Kelly DeToy, Shilah F Waters, Nicole La Ruta, Yeonsoo Baik, Carolina Cardona, Carolina Duque, Robert H Gilman, Bryan N Patenaude
pmc-12554062.description: SummaryBackgroundChagas disease (ChD) presents a growing concern in the United States (US), stemming largely from Chagas cardiomyopathy, a severe complication linked to heart failure, arrhythmias, and sudden death. This condition not only has health impacts in the form of morbidity and premature mortality but also carries significant economic burden related to its cost of care.

pmc-12614801.title: The long-term impact of obesity in pregnancy on offspring hypothalamic feeding pathways
pmc-12614801.creator: Pit Shan Chong, Laura Dearden
pmc-12614801.description: An accumulating body of evidence shows that offspring exposure to maternal obesity in the peri-natal period causes an increased risk to develop obesity later in life. Animal models have demonstrated that increased weight gain in offspring exposed to maternal obesity is preceded by increased food intake, implicating altered brain control of food intake as a likely cause.

pmc-12631888.title: UCP2 Upregulates ACSL3 to Enhance Lipid Droplet Release from Acinar Cells and Modulates the Sirt1/Smad3 Pathway to Promote Macrophage‐to‐Myofibroblast Transition in Chronic Pancreatitis
pmc-12631888.creator: Kunpeng Wang, Lilong Zhang, Beiying Deng, Wanrong Jiang, Tianrui Kuang, Chen Chen, Kailiang Zhao, Qiao Shi, Jun He, Weixing Wang
pmc-12631888.description: Chronic pancreatitis (CP) is a progressive inflammatory disease characterized by pancreatic fibrosis and functional decline. Here, we identify macrophage‐to‐myofibroblast transition (MMT) as a novel feature of CP and investigate the role of mitochondrial uncoupling protein 2 (UCP2) in this process.

pmc-12723174.title: A Case of Myxedema Coma in a 48-Year-Old Female Presenting With Altered Mental Status Post-trauma
pmc-12723174.creator: Rohini Bhuvaneshwari Gurumoorthy, Learned Gonzales
pmc-12723174.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Myxedema coma is a life-threatening endocrine emergency characterized by altered mental status, hypothermia, and multi-organ system dysfunction. It often arises from long-standing, severe hypothyroidism and can be precipitated by acute stressors like trauma, infection, myocardial infarction, or surgery. Given the high mortality rate, immediate treatment with thyroid hormone replacement and stress doses of hydrocortisone (until coexisting adrenal insufficiency is ruled out) must be initiated immediately upon suspicion, before laboratory confirmation.

pmc-13317352.title: Health and safety considerations for healthcare simulation: a scoping review of published literature
pmc-13317352.creator: Angela O’Dea, Paul O’Connor, Sinéad Lydon, Bronwyn Reid-McDermott, Dara Byrne
pmc-13317352.description: BackgroundThe unique environments created within healthcare simulations may create distinct health and safety risks for patients, learners, simulation faculty and staff, and other participants involved in these activities. Guidance to aid simulationists to manage the physical risks arising from simulation activities is limited and there is no integrated synthesis of known risks or risk mitigation strategies.

pmc-13580787.title: FXR1‐Directed Alternative Splicing of MK5 Drives Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression by Activating GSK3β Signaling
pmc-13580787.creator: Yutong Li, Jin Xiang, Bin Cheng, Chenhao Li, Kai Wang, Ni Tang, Luyi Huang
pmc-13580787.description: Alternative splicing plays a crucial role in the development and progression of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the underlying regulatory mechanisms and therapeutic potential remain largely unexplored. Here, we identified the RNA‐binding protein FMR1 autosomal homolog 1 (FXR1) as a key driver of HCC pathogenesis through the regulation of alternative splicing.
